test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The given sentence contains a grammatical error. Identify the segment that contains the error.**

Gopi’s father asked him not stay out late again.
solution: The erroneous part is **'not stay out'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, '**not to stay out**' should be used instead of '**not stay out**'. • The given sentence is in '**indirect speech**' and an example of **an imperative sentence.** • We know that ''**to**' is followed by '**V1 (stay)**'. • *Example: The queen ordered his servant **to cook** her some delicious food that day. * • Thus, the correct answer is** Option 2.** **Correct Sentence:__** *Gopi's father asked him **not to stay** out late again.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां** 'not stay out'** के स्थान पर **'not to stay out'** का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए। • दिया गया वाक्य **'indirect speech' **में है और** imperative sentence **का उदाहरण है। • हम जानते हैं कि '**to**' के बाद** 'V1 (stay)' **आता है। • *Example: The queen ordered his servant **to cook** her some delicious food that day. * • अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 2** है। 3d:T4ca, The correct answer is '**Sandwich**'.
